replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
First of all, Avicus is dipping down to a really low players count. If we split the server between EU and US, then we'll have an issue. Also, whoever said that the community will split, I think you're right. I also see a ginormous problem with the moderators. The time zones are messed up. If we split our mod team to moderate 2 servers, I think it'll be more of an issue than a solution. We're gonna have rule breakers in the morning on US and rule breakers at night on EU. It just makes moderating 5x harder than it already is. I'm not even done. I highly doubt we have the equipment and time to spend on another server. We have 2 devs and they're having a difficult time keeping up to the community's demands from what I can tell. And if you're getting killed by these "latency gods" then I wouldn't consider yourself on the level of PvP skill in which you think you are.

Thats all from me.

replies.author: Atdit
replies.body:
It won't happen, because it isn't possible. And if it is, it would be VERY expensive.

Why?

-New Plugins have to be coded
-AFAIK, the EU server and the US server will need a very very very strong fiber  connection through the atlantic ocean, to interact together in real time, and to avoid  ping crashes/lagg.
-It will be very very very laggy 
-Some players won't even join because it will be so laggy
-Players with a current ping of 200-300 will timeout many times a session.

Please correct me if I am wrong here, but to make "EU and US players play together (One on avic.us, one on avic.eu)" real, would be a hard challenge for each developer :/
